text:
marta: Following the RCA, we need a tighter ownership handoff. Proposal: an 'ownership baton' field in each ticket + an SLA clock (3 business days for remediation plan, 10 business days for rollout). Starter items: RW-4205, RW-4210, RW-4217. Who picks up the baton for week 1?
taylor: I can pick week 1. I'll own RW-4205 (cache eviction tuning) and RW-4210 (alert threshold tuning).
mina: I'll be secondary on RW-4217 (runbook + dashboard updates).
priya: Taylor, please add acceptance criteria, rollback steps, and set the baton field to {"current_owner":"taylor","handoff_deadline":"2024-08-02"}. Also add a 'verification_owner' who will run the 72h post-deploy checks.
taylor: Adding ACs: RW-4205 -> "95th latency down >=25% or toggle revertable within 15m"; RW-4210 -> "alert noise reduced by 70% in staging window". Rollback steps + verification_owner=kevin. ETA for plan: Tue EOD.
kevin: I'll be verification_owner. I'll add the smoke test snippet in RW-4205: ```
SELECT count(1) FROM requests WHERE status = 'error' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```expected threshold: < 100/hour.
priya: Good. Also add a small 'sla_clock' field with timestamps so PMs can auto-query overdue items.
ops-bot: Reminder: PM action checklist due in 4 days for incident 2024-07-28.
marta: I'll add RACI to the doc: R=Taylor (current baton), A=Marta (PM), C=EngSRE+Observability, I=Platform. Backstop=mina. Any objections?
mina: fine by me. I'll take over if Taylor gets blocked. Please add a handoff note in the ticket explaining the 3-day plan requirement.
jira-bot: Created epic RW-4200: "Ownership-baton remediation sprint" and linked RW-4205, RW-4210, RW-4217.
priya: For tracking recurring incidents, add tag `recurrence:2+` if similar incident happened twice in last 30 days. That should trigger an extended RCA.
taylor: tagged RW-4205 as recurrence:2+. Also set ticket label "sprint-baton-week1" so ops dashboards pick it up. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4205 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4210 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4217
kevin: I'll run the smoke tests after the config toggle in staging and post results to the ticket. If error rate > threshold, rollback immediately and notify backlog.
marta: cadence: daily 10m stand for baton week, Fri 3pm wrap to confirm verification steps done. Taylor please post short daily updates (2 lines max) in this thread. If baton is passed, update `current_owner` and set `handoff_deadline`. Closing loop here, thanks all. :white_check_mark:
